title: pepkio-biostat-test-navigator v0.1.0 – a Python client for automated biostatistical test selection and hypothesis evaluation via the Pepkio life-science calculator suite
description: Long-term preservation of **pepkio-biostat-test-navigator** on Zenodo establishes a citable, version-pinned Python client for automated biostatistical decision logic, normality and homoscedasticity assumption checks, and parametric versus non-parametric hypothesis testing across experimental life-science workflows. The archived package preserves v0.1.0 of the open-source lab calculator API wrapper to guarantee computational reproducibility across automated analysis pipelines, delegating statistical decision trees, post-hoc adjustments, and effect size calculations to the hosted Pepkio calculator API without bundling complex statistical dependencies locally. Source code and the issue tracker are maintained at https://github.com/pepkio/pepkio-biostat-test-navigator. The primary interactive platform for the same calculations is the [Pepkio Biostat Test Navigator](https://www.pepkio.com/tools/biostat-test-navigator), part of a Pepkio suite of more than thirty web tools covering solution prep, PCR, cell culture, assays, pharmacology, education, and sequence utilities. The Python client supports batch evaluations, multi-group dataset processing, and pipeline integration in Jupyter, Nextflow, and Snakemake. Released under the MIT License; Pepkio (https://www.pepkio.com/) develops laboratory calculators and analysis services (https://www.pepkio.com/cro) for life science research.
notes:
**Suggested citation.** When referencing the archived client in a publication, cite the Zenodo DOI together with the GitHub repository (https://github.com/pepkio/pepkio-biostat-test-navigator) and record the client version (v0.1.0) in methods or supplementary materials.

**Programmatic access.** This client is the recommended interface for scripted calls to the Pepkio Biostat Test Navigator API; the interactive web application remains available for manual test selection and visual exploration. Calculator logic resides on Pepkio servers; this package transmits parameters and returns structured results only.
